- Run `track-only` policies through one-shot ACP exec instead of persistent named prompt sessions.
- Skip session bundle restore/backup for non-persistent `track-only` runs.
- Add review-synthesis grounding guidance and update session policy docs/tests.

Closes #267

Minor gap: regression coverage asserts ACP args and policy behavior, but does not model two consecutive synthesis runs with contradictory artifacts as suggested in #267. |

## Notes

- The strongest rubric alignment is that the PR fixes the root cause directly: `track-only` no longer maps to persistent ACP mode, while `tracksThreadState("track-only")` remains true through the unchanged policy contract.
- Docs are updated in the right places for user-facing behavior and generated action guidance.
- The only rubric-specific follow-up worth considering is a fuller regression for stale synthesis across consecutive runs, but the current unit tests cover the most important contracts.

## Findings

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: f74071f72e9d8c4d7f957f5fa1de71a9c111b8e4 -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #268 addresses #267, where `track-only` review synthesis could reuse stale persistent ACP session context.
- The PR changes `track-only` to one-shot `exec` mode while preserving thread-state metadata.
- It also skips session bundles for non-persistent `track-only` runs and updates docs to describe the new policy semantics.
- The review synthesis prompt now requires blocking findings to be grounded in current review artifacts or the current diff.

## Review
The stale-session fix is directionally correct, but the current implementation loses Codex reasoning-effort setup for the affected `track-only` lanes. This is blocking because review and synthesis jobs still request high effort, and the new exec path no longer applies it.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Codex track-only exec drops requested reasoning effort | BLOCKING | `track-only` now enters exec mode, but Codex `thought_level` is only applied during persistent session setup. Codex review/synthesis lanes that request `xhigh` would silently run at the backend default effort. |
| Non-blocking polish noted by reviewers | INFO | Reviewers also noted optional cleanup around `always` bundle-mode wording, test coupling, and missing full two-run synthesis regression coverage. These are not required before fixing the runtime regression. |

## Progress
- The PR correctly splits `track-only` metadata tracking from persistent named session reuse.
- Docs, prompt guidance, and targeted unit tests were updated for the intended stale-context fix.
- Rubrics review passed and found the implementation generally surgical and aligned with #267.
- Posted one inline comment on `.agent/src/session-policy.ts:33` for the reasoning-effort regression.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Codex track-only exec drops requested reasoning effort</summary>

**Cause:** [`sessionModeForPolicy("track-only")`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f74071f72e9d8c4d7f957f5fa1de71a9c111b8e4/.agent/src/session-policy.ts#L33) now returns `exec`. [`run.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f74071f72e9d8c4d7f957f5fa1de71a9c111b8e4/.agent/src/run.ts#L544) still passes `thoughtLevel`, but [`runAcpx`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f74071f72e9d8c4d7f957f5fa1de71a9c111b8e4/.agent/src/acpx-adapter.ts#L595) skips session setup for exec routes. The Codex `thought_level` command is only emitted by [`buildSessionSetupCommands`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f74071f72e9d8c4d7f957f5fa1de71a9c111b8e4/.agent/src/acpx-adapter.ts#L287), inside the persistent branch.

**Candidate solutions:** Preserve reasoning-effort propagation for Codex exec runs, or use a fresh per-run session path that can set `thought_level` without reusing the stable target/lane session. Add focused coverage proving `track-only` Codex jobs keep the requested effort.

**Comments:** Codex flagged this as blocking; Claude and rubrics review considered the PR shippable. Synthesis agrees with the blocking finding after tracing the current runtime path.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR

Preserve Codex reasoning-effort propagation for exec-mode `track-only` runs; this is a concrete branch change suitable for automated fix-pr.

## Final Verdict
NEEDS_REWORK

## Action Items

- [ ] Add focused regression coverage for Codex `track-only` exec reasoning-effort propagation.
